name: setgroups
synopsis: int setgroups(size_t size, const gid_t *_Nullable list);
description: Sets the supplementary group IDs for the calling process. Appropriate privileges are required to perform this operation. It can be used to drop all supplementary groups by calling with size 0 and NULL as the list.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The number of supplementary group IDs in the array pointed to by list

parameters.name: list
parameters.description: Pointer to an array of gid_t containing the supplementary group IDs, or NULL if size is 0

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: The list has an invalid address
The calling process has insufficient privilege or the use is denied in this user namespace
